name: My Pet Sakura
source:
Chapter 3 of My pet series Fate edition.
Rider says that Sakura is going to be the next sacrifice and disappears. Sakura sets off to find Rider, but finds only humiliation and violation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-february-2007-utsurigi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《我的宠物》系列《Fate》篇第3章。
Rider留下间桐樱将成为下一个牺牲品的预言，随后便消失无踪。樱出发寻找Rider，最终找到的却只有羞辱与侵犯。
